rationale.mechanical: Rigid/deformable slot binding thresholds are frozen subject-free rather than tunable per witness.
rationale.appearance: Adjacent faces inside one mechanical component may be separated when source-backed CAA samples on the two sides of their shared edge exhibit a strong premultiplied-RGBA discontinuity. This realizes presentation segmentation as a distinct observable authority without inventing semantic object labels.
rationale.sampling: Samples are taken slightly inside each incident face to detect region appearance on either side of an edge rather than merely sampling the shared anti-aliased boundary texel.
